title: Strict henselization is ind-etale over an affine chart
statement: Let S be a scheme, s:Spec Ω→S an algebraically closed geometric point, i:Spec R→S an affine open immersion containing the image of the closed point of s, A a commutative ring, e:Spec A≅S_(s), and a:R→A a ring map whose spectrum composed with i equals e followed by the strict henselization structural map. Equip A with the algebra structure induced by a. Then A is ind-etale over R.

proof.text: Factor the geometric point through the chart. Apply etale_local_ring_triples for the chart category equivalence E, diagram comparison, universal cocones and compatible comparison isomorphism t. Apply etaleResidueTriples_filtered_colimit to obtain filteredness, its ring colimit c and compatible map rho from R.

Use isColimitSmallStrictHenselizationCocone to compare the full affine colimit with cn, then t and uniqueness of the triples colimit to obtain ringIso. On a small representative isomorphic to the pointed chart, the diagram comparison and cocone equations identify the R-map. The strictHenselizationStructuralMap_eq equation for the full affine cone and naturality of isoSpec identify its spectrum with strictLocalizationToBase.

Take a small model of the chart category, transport its filtered ring colimit to A using e and ringIso, and form the compatible natural transformation from constant R using the triple structure maps. Cancel the open immersion i and use Spec faithfulness to identify the induced map with a. Each stage is etale by the affine criterion; RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists proves ind-etaleness.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04HX and 04GW; G3, 2026-10-20, records the existing adopted upstream proof after retiring the Sheaf copy. No upstream proof is edited.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω A : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (i : Spec R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (hs : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ Set.range i)
    (e : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictLocalization s)
    (a : R →+* A)
    (ha : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) ≫ i =
      e.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s) :
    letI : Algebra R A := a.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IndEtale R A
lean.note: G3 retirement, 2026-10-20: the upstream theorem uses the full affine colimit. The small-model corollary is lem-weil-pbc-small-strict-henselization-ind-etale, proved by the canonical comparison over the base.
